text: Website Development for Beginners
One-Month Practical HTML Course
Start your website-development journey with Umsad Tech E-Learning Academy. This beginner-friendly course will teach you how to build real webpages from scratch using HTML.
The training is delivered through live online classes, instructor demonstrations, guided practicals, assignments, weekly quizzes and a final website project.
No previous coding experience is required.

Registration Status: Open
Starting Date: 14/09/2026
Closing Date: 30/09/2026
Class Days: Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday
Class Time: See the timetable below.
Duration: Four Weeks
Classes: Three live classes every week
Mode: Live Online Training
Language: English and Hausa
Course Fee: ₦30,000
Level: Beginner
Required Device: Laptop computer
About the Course
The One-Month Practical HTML Course is the first stage of our Website Development Programme. It introduces students to the structure and meaning of webpages.
Students will learn through practical exercises and build something during every class. By the end of the course, each student should be able to create and present a complete four-page HTML website.
This month focuses on HTML. CSS will later be used for visual design, while JavaScript will add interaction and functionality.
Who Can Apply?
This course is suitable for:
Complete beginners with no coding experience.
Students interested in technology and software development.
Business owners who want to understand how websites work.
Jobseekers who want to begin learning digital skills.
Anyone interested in becoming a frontend or full-stack developer.
Anyone who wants to build personal, business or organizational websites.
Applicants must have access to a laptop computer and be willing to practise regularly.
What You Will Learn
During this course, you will learn how to:
Understand how websites and web browsers work.
Create and organize HTML files.
Use headings, paragraphs, emphasis and comments.
Add links and images to webpages.
understand file paths and website folders.
Create ordered, unordered and description lists.
Display structured information using accessible tables.
Build registration, admission and contact forms.
Use input fields, buttons, radio buttons and checkboxes.
Add text areas, selection menus and form validation.
Structure webpages with semantic HTML elements.
Add figures, audio, video and embedded content.
Write clean and accessible HTML.
Find and correct common HTML errors.
Connect multiple webpages through navigation.
Build and present a complete four-page website.
How Every Live Class Will Work
Each live class will last approximately two hours.
Review – 10 minutes: Review the previous lesson and correct homework.
Learning – 25 minutes: Explain the new HTML concepts and important terms.
Instructor demonstration – 20 minutes: The instructor builds an example while sharing the screen.
Guided practical – 40 minutes: Students build the project step by step with the instructor.
Independent task – 20 minutes: Students modify or improve the project themselves.
Recap – 5 minutes: Save the work, ask final questions and receive the assignment.
Students will not only watch the instructor. Everyone will be required to write and test their own code during class.
Course Assessment
Students will be assessed using the following system:
Class practicals: 40%
Weekly quizzes: 20%
Homework assignments: 15%
Final website project: 25%
Applications and Software Required
Every student must prepare the following:
A Windows, macOS or Linux laptop computer.
A functional laptop charger.
A reliable internet connection and sufficient data.
Visual Studio Code.
Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Firefox or Safari.
A valid email address.
An active WhatsApp number.
Google Meet or the platform announced by the academy.
A folder named html-month for saving course work.
A notebook or the official course handbook.
Using only a mobile phone is not recommended because students must write, save, organize and test website files.
How to Apply
Follow these steps to register:
Visit the Umsad Tech E-Learning website.
Click Apply Now or Create Account.
Enter your correct name, email address and password.
Select Website Development for Beginners.
